description: This file defines CLI commands related to LDAP operations in the Mattermost server, including LDAP synchronization, migration of LDAP ID attributes, and listing/showing LDAP sync jobs.

methods.name: newLDAPSyncCmd
methods.description: Creates a new command for LDAP synchronization.

methods.name: ldapSyncCmdF
methods.description: Executes LDAP sync operation via client.

methods.name: ldapJobShowCmdF
methods.description: Shows details of a specific LDAP sync job.

methods.name: ldapJobShowCompletionF
methods.description: Provides completion for LDAP job IDs.
